handling_notes: Summary metrics only (no time series): CMJ height, DJ contact time/height, 20 m sprint, L-run, maturity offset (Mirwald), with Pre1-3/Post1-3 attempts. Device and jump-height method not stated: never treat as reference for estimand-specific grading.
privacy_notes: 45 male adolescent soccer players aged 10-18 (minors); ethics approval and registration stated. Contains a free-text 'Reason for exclusion' column with health categories (Injury, Illness): this column must be dropped on conversion (no free-text medical notes). Squad-level use only with n >= 10.

source.citation: Holik, Krejci, Lehnert (2025) Zenodo 17881835; trial NCT06406764

title: Plyometric training in youth soccer players with maturation status (RCT dataset)
